candidates.title: Metronome: Bound the Cache, Keep the Beat for Real-Time Interaction Model Serving
candidates.reason: Metronome treats growing KV state as a real-time serving failure mode and bounds cache growth while preserving recurring frame deadlines, directly extending KV-memory management and latency-SLO serving lineages.

candidates.title: KVpop - Key-Value Cache Compression with Predictive Online Pruning
candidates.reason: KVpop learns fixed-budget online eviction from future-attention supervision rather than static proxy scores, directly extending adaptive KV eviction and long-context memory-management lineages.

candidates.title: TransformKV: Optimizing Multi-Turn Conversational Services in LLMs via KV Cache Transformation
candidates.reason: TransformKV transforms prior-turn KV state for reuse instead of fully recomputing growing conversation context, directly updating multi-turn prefix/KV reuse and TTFT reduction lineages.

candidates.title: RaBitQCache: Rotated Binary Quantization for KVCache in Long Context LLM Inference
candidates.reason: RaBitQCache combines randomized rotated binary quantization with adaptive sparse retrieval and high-throughput low-bit arithmetic, directly extending KV quantization and sparse-attention lineages.

candidates.title: Fractal KV-Cache Archives: Lossless Symbolic Storage with In-Place Retrieval for Long-Context LLM Inference
candidates.reason: Fractal KV-Cache Archives focuses on how quantized KV symbol streams are stored and retrieved in-place, adding a storage-layer design point to KV compression and hierarchical-memory lineages.
